title: Noise sensitivity of odd-dimensional majority
statement: For any $\delta\in[0,1]$, the noise sensitivity of majority on $2k+1$ sign coordinates, with each coordinate independently flipped with probability $\delta$, tends as $k\to\infty$ to $\arccos(1-2\delta)/\pi$.
